metadata.title: Golden Hour Portrait with Butterfly Accent

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, monochromatic-leaning portrait featuring a subject with dynamic, wind-swept hair and a small, high-contrast butterfly accent.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman with voluminous, wind-swept honey-blonde hair, wearing a tan strapless tube top and a delicate waist chain, set against a solid warm brown background. A single monarch butterfly rests on her hand, providing a focal point of color.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a monochromatic warm background
Dynamic hair movement framing the face
Small, saturated butterfly contrasting with the muted palette
Soft, diffused studio lighting creating a golden glow
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm brown and tan color palette
Presence of a small butterfly as a symbolic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally framed from the waist up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the butterfly resting on the hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the flow of the hair from the top left, down to the face, and then to the butterfly on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform warm brown space surrounding the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and ochre tones in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns in the hair shadows and eye makeup.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and black of the monarch butterfly.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value consistency, except for the saturated butterfly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with long, wind-blown honey-blonde hair against a solid warm brown backdrop, wearing a tan strapless top and a waist chain, with a monarch butterfly on her hand.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, apply a thin, elegant serif font in a cream color with light tracking.

verificationChecks: Ensure hair has a sense of motion
Check that the butterfly is the only high-saturation element
Verify the monochromatic warm color grade

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wind effect on hair
postGenerationChecks: Is the background a consistent warm brown?
Does the hair appear dynamic and voluminous?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a monochromatic warm studio setting with dynamic hair movement and a single, small, high-contrast natural element.
